direction: Daily channel breakout confirmed by Chaikin Money Flow, separate BTC/ETH cash sleeves
hypothesis: A breakout that closes in the upper part of its daily range on volume-weighted accumulation may filter low-quality price-only breakouts. This is a testable hypothesis, not an asserted edge; the indicator and thresholds are fixed before results.

literature_context.source: TA-Lib CMF indicator definition and implementation spec
literature_context.scope: Defines the money-flow multiplier and trailing-volume-normalized CMF calculation; does not validate this BTC/ETH trading rule.

literature_context.source: Marc Chaikin, The Birth of Chaikin Money Flow
literature_context.scope: Origin context for weighting close location inside the high-low range by trading volume; not evidence of crypto profitability.

prior_work.initial16_audit: research/experiments/20261012T035429Z/prior_evidence_audit.json records actual backtest evidence for all 16 initial entries; no initial result-available=false research spec is eligible for backfill.
prior_work.unavailable_registry_rows: The 58 unresolved latest rows are 40 paper-live-portfolio-observation blocked rows owned by btc-eth-2 and 18 abandoned lead-lag drafts; they are not missing initial research backtests and will be left unchanged.
prior_work.related_families: Existing close-channel, OBV/SMA, volume-confirmed-channel, volatility-compression, lead-lag and momentum families were reviewed. CMF uses volume-weighted close location within each completed bar; it is economically distinct from OBV sign accumulation, though all are related volume confirmation research and share historical-selection limitations.
prior_work.historical_selection: The 2025-09-19..2026-09-14 window is repeatedly reused development/OOS history and is not an untouched holdout.

data.exchange: Binance spot archived 1-minute OHLCV, aggregated to UTC daily OHLCV; timestamps and closed flags must be continuous and all OOS closes completed before decision.
data.holdout_note: OOS data have been repeatedly searched; not a final holdout.

rule.entry: At each completed UTC daily close t, require close[t] strictly greater than max(high[t-E:t]); the E prior daily bars exclude the compared signal-day bar. Also require CMF_N[t] strictly greater than 0.05. If both pass and the sleeve is flat, desire long.
rule.exit: At each completed UTC daily close t, exit an existing long when close[t] is strictly less than min(low[t-30:t]); the 30 prior bars exclude the compared signal-day bar. CMF is entry confirmation only; it never independently exits.
rule.cmf: For each completed bar j, multiplier=(2*close[j]-high[j]-low[j])/(high[j]-low[j]); use 0 when high==low. money_flow_volume=multiplier*quote_volume[j]. CMF_N[t]=sum(money_flow_volume[t-N+1:t+1])/sum(quote_volume[t-N+1:t+1]); return 0 if denominator is 0. The signal bar is included because its full OHLCV is available at its close. Raw range is [-1,+1]; no *100 scaling.
rule.execution: Signal availability is daily bar open time + 86400000ms. Execute any state change only at the next UTC day 00:01 1-minute bar open, after the daily close is available. OOS begins with cash at 2025-09-19 00:01 UTC and ends by terminal liquidation at 2026-09-14 00:01 UTC. Never fill at the signal close or past historical price after a delayed decision.
rule.allocation: One 2,000 USDT portfolio with independent BTC and ETH long-only sleeves, raw initial weights 0.50/0.50 (1,000 USDT each). No leverage, shorting, interest, cross-sleeve transfers or rebalancing. A sleeve holds only its own coin plus residual USDT.
rule.close_channel: Entry and exit extrema are computed solely from completed bars before t; the signal-day close/high/low are never included in the channel being compared.

grid.sensitivity: Full predeclared 3x3 entry-lookback by CMF-lookback grid; the two varied axes are independent; all nine combinations retained.

cost_model.impact: 0.5 * sample standard deviation of previous 20 complete daily log returns * sqrt(order quote budget / mean quote volume of previous 20 complete UTC days)

exchange_snapshot.filters: PRICE_FILTER, LOT_SIZE, NOTIONAL, and PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE from current Binance spot exchangeInfo; historical percent-price reference approximated using prior five completed 1-minute closes.

benchmark_read_only.note: Read-only exact same dates, independent 1,000-USDT sleeves and costs; no repeated benchmark evaluation in this batch.
